title: 9 Signs a Godly Man Isn't Performing for Anyone
caption:
There's a church version, a gym version, a group-chat version, and a private-browser version of most men. That's the split Scripture calls being double-minded.

A godly man isn't performing for any of the rooms he walks into. Same volume online as at the dinner table. Same guy in the pew as in the comment section.

Run these nine and see how many are actually true of you this week, not how many you'd like to be true.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #integrity #authenticity
